*** Update File: /mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/codex/solver/cuda/README.md
@@
 global/split/CME comparisons and a short wide96 case require identical snapshot
 arrays, probe bytes and retry/diagnostic statistics in `validate_async.py`.
+
+`mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld` is a separate contact/Alfvén-resolving control using
+`flux_variant=split_hlld`. The shared float/double `hlld_kernel.hpp` implements
+the five-wave construction of Miyoshi and Kusano(2005),
+https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2005.02.017, with coordinate-free tangential vectors.
+Formula/degeneracy review used the official Athena++ implementation; its source
+attribution and BSD license are preserved in HLLD_ATTRIBUTION.txt and
+HLLD_ATHENA_BSD_LICENSE.txt. The common interface q²/2 is excluded from every MHD
+star energy; the common GLM energy flux ch*q*Bn is added afterward, with exact
+normal-B/q fluxes. No cleaning energy is advected with the MHD velocity.
+
+Near-degenerate denominators(relative tolerance1e-6), nonpositive density or gas
+pressure in either star family, inconsistent wave ordering, or nonfinite flux
+select the local HLLE flux. Nothing is clipped. `hlld_fallbacks.json` counts each
+reason and every interface evaluation, including rejected RK attempts. A zero
+normal field retains the contact-resolving hydrodynamic limit when regular.
+`step_histogram.csv` records accepted steps, global first-order fallback steps and
+rejected attempts by the integer UTC day at step start. Those are separate from
+the interface HLLE fallbacks.
+
+`build_hlld.py`, `validate_hlld.py`, `hlld_cpu/flux_checks.cpp`,
+`hlld_cpu/glm_energy_check.cpp` and `hlld_cpu/verify_brio.py` reproduce the checks.
+The64-bit CUDA reference rejects nonempty cone input; the32-bit production
+control retains the cone and E interfaces. Complete25day CPU/CUDA64 coarse runs
+have identical snapshot arrays, probe bytes, timestep/retry/divB statistics,
+interface counters and daily histograms. FP32 maximum PN incident-flux precision
+difference is0.400%(mean0.184%); local transverse-velocity and magnetic snapshot
+differences are larger. This meets the1% proton-flux gate, not the original0.1%
+precision target, and does not establish mesh or input convergence.
*** Update File: /mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/codex/solver/cuda/VERIFICATION.md
@@
 solar-wind method or mesh convergence by itself.
+
+The separate HLLD contact/Alfvén control passes stationary/moving MHD and
+hydrodynamic contacts, stationary/moving rotational Alfvén discontinuities,
+superfast upwind branches and rotated-vector checks in float/double. Constant-q
+contact flux checks verify that cleaning energy is excluded from MHD advection.
+Deliberate degenerate and rarefaction states exercise counted HLLE fallbacks.
+Independent Athena8192 density L1 decreases0.011826→0.007975→0.005273 at400/800/1600;
+the1600 tube uses zero HLLE fallbacks across5.56million interface calls.
+
+`validation/hlld_production_coarse_agreement.json` records exact CPU/CUDA64
+snapshot/probe/statistics/counter/histogram agreement over6420steps and570 global
+first-order fallbacks. The latter occur during the PN days, not only spin-up:
+UTCdays32–33 have62/496 globally downgraded accepted steps(12.5%); this is an
+integer-day aggregate, not an exact GTI weighting. Interface-local HLLE fallbacks
+are~3.01% of406.93million evaluations, predominantly nonphysical stars. FP32 has
+one fewer final step but the same570 global fallback steps; PN incident-flux
+precision differences are mean+0.184%, maximum0.400%. Whole-volume transverse
+velocity Linf reaches9.15% of that component's maximum and magnetic components
+up to4.93%; strong local sensitivity remains despite the acceptable proton-probe
+precision. Parent HLLD sources and formula header are frozen for controlled
+thermodynamic and performance derivatives.
*** End Patch"));
